title: RegVelo 三空间实验室
variant: 六维表达与三维潜变量；直接重建实验及独立的时间解码—两池动力学联合拟合实验，共用观测数据

automatic_optimization.control_location: right side of the top cell/decoder toolbar on all six routes
automatic_optimization.selection: best mean objective across 8 fixed evaluation noise batches, independent of fresh training epsilon; same cells, not held-out validation
automatic_optimization.stopping: at least 100 epochs, stop after 100 without accumulated score improvement greater than 0.001*max(1,abs(reference_score)); user budget 100/500/1000/3000/10000, default 1000
automatic_optimization.restore: restore best weights, Adam moments/counters and training noise generator counter; preserve actual update count; display selected checkpoint separately
automatic_optimization.pause: manual pause or navigation stops work and restores the best automatic checkpoint
automatic_optimization.validation: passed: top controls unique on all routes; automatic run completes; plateau/cap/pause; reported loss matches restored model; continued Adam updates match the saved checkpoint for both models

teaching_model.encoder: fixed feature standardization -> 8 ReLU hidden units -> 3 means and 3 Softplus variances
teaching_model.decoder: full 3D mean or sample -> 8 ReLU hidden units -> 6 Softplus expression means
teaching_model.ellipsoids: one 3D Gaussian contour per cell, centered at mu with semiaxes k*sqrt(variance); exact orthographic silhouettes; k=1, 2 or 2.795483482915 for 95% mass; sampled decoder points do not move the center
teaching_model.kinetics: legacy space page only: regression from assumed synthetic group ordering, not RegVelo joint inference; used for illustrative velocity arrows
teaching_model.umap: deterministic teaching UMAP-style fuzzy k-neighbor projection of 3D latent means to 2D; group-wise temporal paths are connected and kinetic velocity is mapped to arrow direction
teaching_model.training: fresh independent epsilon for every cell/dimension each full-batch epoch; Gaussian NLL sigma=0.3; KL weight=0.05; Adam lr=0.008; fixed 8-noise assessment batches only for scoring
teaching_model.data: deterministic synthetic observations; color labels do not enter the loss
teaching_model.not_implemented: this direct-reconstruction model omits gene-time decoder and RNA ODE; see the independent dynamics_teaching_model for a differentiable ODE example

dynamics_teaching_model.data: same 24 synthetic six-dimensional observations as NetworkLab; group labels and known ordering never enter the joint loss
dynamics_teaching_model.path: 6 standardized features -> 8 ReLU -> 3 means and variances -> reparameterized z -> 8 ReLU -> 3 sigmoid gene-specific times -> coupled three-gene ODE -> 6 expression predictions
dynamics_teaching_model.time: t_ig = 4 * sigmoid(time_head_g(z_i)); no observed real times or calibrated clock units
dynamics_teaching_model.field: alpha_g(s) = Softplus(b_g + sum_j W_gj*s_j); du_g/dt = alpha_g(s)-beta_g*u_g; ds_g/dt = beta_g*u_g-gamma_g*s_g
dynamics_teaching_model.positive_rates: beta and gamma use unconstrained raw parameters transformed by Softplus
dynamics_teaching_model.integration: differentiable fixed 12-step RK4 from u(0)=s(0)=0; full three-gene state integrated at each gene-specific time; read out matching gene components
dynamics_teaching_model.objective: Gaussian NLL sigma=0.2 + 0.05*KL + 0.001*sum(W^2); fresh epsilon per training update; preview draws and fixed 8-batch score independent of training
dynamics_teaching_model.optimization: actual reverse-mode differentiation through all RK4 stages; Adam lr=0.008; gradient norm clipped at 10; per-parameter step counters
dynamics_teaching_model.experiments: joint, rates, time, encoder, GRN, beta and gamma group updates; each module has a 10-epoch fine-tuning control; parameter sliders; observation cursor independent of learned time
dynamics_teaching_model.limitations: small teaching implementation, not complete RegVelo; no batch/layer normalization, dropout, learnable observation noise, graph priors or original auxiliary constraints; fixed zero root and relative time scale; kinetic parameters need not be uniquely identifiable

validation.numerical: passed: six-dimensional standardization, 3D gradient finite differences, ellipsoid surface equation and rotated projection, two-pool kinetics, 2D embedding, raw-vector decoding and 100 actual updates
validation.interactions: passed: shared fixed-shape model across six pages, ellipsoid scope and contour changes preserve decoder input, two-pool kinetics table and 24-point UMAP state render, resampling preserves mean and variance, linked cell selection, perturbation, sampling, rotation handlers, training, pause, legacy aliases and reset in a Node DOM/canvas harness
validation.dynamics_numerical: passed 2026-10-26: numeric/AD loss agreement, finite differences, analytic constant-alpha solution, mass balance, integration convergence, frozen groups and fresh-noise training; 30 updates reduce the fixed-preview loss from 17.7221474337 to 0.4269529930
validation.dynamics_interactions: passed 2026-10-26 in Node DOM/canvas harness: six stages, same observations, gene-specific times, resampling invariance, cursor independence, parameter sliders, all three fitting modes, real joint training, play/pause, rotation, resize, independent persistent models and route-change cancellation
validation.visual: passed 2026-10-26: Chrome 156.0.8078.47 real-browser check across 1440/390/320 widths, six routes and offline build; console errors 0; screenshots and report in .checks/
validation.sampling: passed: fresh epsilon across all cells/dimensions, independent preview, 8-batch assessment equality, arbitrary-noise gradient checks, frozen module scopes, optimizer and RNG checkpoint continuation

layout: three vertically stacked expression/latent/reconstruction rows at all widths; existing 3D ellipsoids retained

regvelo_output_semantics.rates: beta/gamma and W/b are fitted shared point parameters, read directly; no average over genes or latent axes
regvelo_output_semantics.expression: local rgv_expression_fit defaults to n_samples=1, return_mean=True; for M>1 it runs posterior samples through decoder and ODE then averages over the sample axis
regvelo_output_semantics.preview: website expression preview still follows selected mean or single latent sample; it is not relabeled a posterior prediction mean
